feeding_claim.verbatim: Barney York provides premium grass-fed and grass/grain-fed beef.

notes: Black Angus. Two options: grass-fed cattle fed only ranch grass, and grass/grain-fed cattle supplemented with grain for 90 to 120 days (another line on the same page says 90 days). Only half or whole beef, $7.50 per lb hanging weight, processed at Arizona Mobile Meat in Williams. Orders by phone, text or email to Kelsey; delivery to Prescott area customers only. No shipping or pickup stated. No street address published (contact page has placeholder text).
